project_name: Plan a go-to-market campaign for a
description: Plan a go-to-market campaign for a new campus meal subscription service targeting students, including channel strategy, launch assets, and weekly performance review.
summary: A medium complexity digital marketing campaign in the business domain.

phases.name: Market and Audience Research
phases.objective: Clarify audience, positioning, and success metrics.

tasks.title: Define audience
tasks.description: Document target segments, pain points, and buying triggers.
acceptance_criteria: Define audience is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

tasks.title: Set campaign goals
tasks.description: Define measurable goals such as leads, signups, conversion, or awareness.
acceptance_criteria: Set campaign goals is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

phases.name: Strategy and Content Planning
phases.objective: Select channels, messages, budget assumptions, and content plan.

tasks.title: Choose channels
tasks.description: Select channels based on audience and budget.
acceptance_criteria: Choose channels is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

tasks.title: Create content calendar
tasks.description: Plan launch assets, publishing cadence, and owners.
acceptance_criteria: Create content calendar is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

phases.name: Launch Execution
phases.objective: Run campaign activities and monitor performance.

tasks.title: Launch campaign
tasks.description: Publish assets and activate selected channels.
acceptance_criteria: Launch campaign is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

tasks.title: Track performance
tasks.description: Monitor results and adjust targeting or messaging.
acceptance_criteria: Track performance is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

milestones.name: Market and Audience Research Complete
milestones.description: All deliverables for Market and Audience Research are complete and reviewed.

milestones.name: Strategy and Content Planning Complete
milestones.description: All deliverables for Strategy and Content Planning are complete and reviewed.

milestones.name: Launch Execution Complete
milestones.description: All deliverables for Launch Execution are complete and reviewed.

risks.mitigation: Confirm requirements and acceptance criteria before implementation.
